title: euodia malayana
intro: Euodia malayana, commonly known as Malay pepper tree, is a plant species native to Malaysia and Southeast Asia, belonging to the Rutaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Euodia malayana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cytotoxic activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential applications of Euodia malayana in traditional medicine and modern pharmacology.
